headline: Coca-Cola Stock Pops After Earnings Shine a Light on Consumer Spending
summary: Coca-Cola  stock was rising on Tuesday after the soft drink company reported better-than-expected earnings and raised its full-year guidance, signaling to investors that demand for fizzy drinks remains robust.  Coca-Cola reported adjusted earnings of 97 cents a share, as revenue jumped 7% from a year ago to $13.4 billion.  Analysts were expecting earnings of 93 cents a share on revenue of $13.2 billion, according to a FactSet poll.
